correctness.rationale: The folded-saddle branch is analytic by the implicit function theorem since the u-derivative of its defining polynomial is b>0 at r=0. Exact third-order equilibrium and second-order stable eigenslope jets are computed. Graph invariance and f_uu(1,1/c;0)=0 force stable-graph curvature h_r"(u*)=O_a(r^2), eliminating all curvature contributions through r^3 to the section crossing. Smooth strong-stable fibers of the normally attracting r=0 equilibrium line justify the fourth-order Taylor remainder. Series inversion at positive derivative 2/(bc) proves the stated rate law, and the polynomial 4b^3+b^2-1 is strictly increasing for b>0 with one root. The standalone standard-library checker passed 1,939 exact-rational jet-identity groups for 277 rational b values; numerical checks are corroboration only, not the continuum proof.

value.rationale: The exact cubic term produces a qualitative, unique crossover in the sign of the first correction not fixed by the published positive first and second terms. Consequently, it decides whether that widely used quadratic critical-rate estimate is above or below the true singular canard threshold at small displacement, across the full interior Allee parameter range. Reaching this conclusion requires controlling stable-separatrix curvature and is directly motivated by the published critical-rate estimate; it is not arbitrary selection of one parameter or a routine renaming.
